description: Provenance figure: LNPK zinc finger topology, geometry, secondary structure and Foldseek classification vs RING/U-box
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15,10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3,2, height_ratios=[1.15,1,1], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.28)

# ---------------- Panel A: zinc-ligand topology ----------------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
domains = [
 ("LNPK Q9C0E8  (276-301)",  276, 301, [(276,'C'),(279,'C'),(298,'C'),(301,'C')],
   [([276,279,298,301],'#1f77b4')], '#1f77b4'),
 ("TFIIS zinc ribbon 1TFI",   12,  43, [(12,'C'),(15,'C'),(40,'C'),(43,'C')],
   [([12,15,40,43],'#1f77b4')], '#1f77b4'),
 ("RNF4 RING 4AP4 (136-180)",136, 180, [(136,'C'),(139,'C'),(158,'C'),(160,'H'),(163,'C'),(166,'C'),(177,'C'),(180,'C')],
   [([136,139,163,166],'#d62728'),([158,160,177,180],'#ff9896')], '#d62728'),
 ("c-CBL RING 1FBV (381-419)",381,419,[(381,'C'),(384,'C'),(396,'C'),(398,'H'),(401,'C'),(404,'C'),(416,'C'),(419,'C')],
   [([381,384,401,404],'#d62728'),([396,398,416,419],'#ff9896')], '#d62728'),
]
for k,(name,s,e,ligs,sites,col) in enumerate(domains):
    y = len(domains)-k
    axA.plot([0,1],[y,y],color='0.75',lw=3,solid_capstyle='round',zorder=1)
    span = e-s
    pos = {p:(p-s)/span for p,_ in ligs}
    # arcs for each zinc site
    for ligset,c in sites:
        for a,b in zip(ligset[:-1],ligset[1:]):
            xa,xb = pos[a],pos[b]
            axA.plot(np.linspace(xa,xb,40), y+0.30*np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi,40))*(1 if c in('#1f77b4','#d62728') else -1),
                     color=c, lw=1.8, zorder=2)
    for p,aa in ligs:
        axA.scatter(pos[p], y, s=130, color=col if aa=='C' else 'white',
                    edgecolor=col, lw=1.8, zorder=3)
        axA.text(pos[p], y-0.33, f"{aa}{p}", ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, rotation=0)
    axA.text(-0.02, y, name, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=10)
    nz = len(sites)
    axA.text(1.02, y, f"{len(ligs)} ligands, {nz} Zn\n{'sequential' if nz==1 else 'cross-brace'}",
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, color=col)
axA.set_xlim(-0.33,1.33); axA.set_ylim(0.3, len(domains)+0.8); axA.axis('off')
axA.set_title("A  Zinc-ligand topology: LNPK matches a sequential zinc ribbon, not the cross-brace RING\n"
              "(ligand identities taken from PDB Zn coordination, cutoff 2.9 A; LNPK from AlphaFold AF-Q9C0E8-F1)",
              fontsize=11, loc='left')

# ---------------- Panel B: AF Zn-site geometry ----------------
meta=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q9C0E8',headers=H,timeout=60).json()[0]
aftxt=requests.get(meta['pdbUrl'],headers=H,timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for l in aftxt.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        rows.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),ri=int(l[22:26]),x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows)
ligs=[276,279,298,301]
sg={r:A[(A.ri==r)&(A.name=='SG')][['x','y','z']].values[0] for r in ligs}
cen=np.mean(list(sg.values()),axis=0)
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
d=[np.linalg.norm(sg[i]-sg[j]) for ii,i in enumerate(ligs) for j in ligs[ii+1:]]
labs=[f"C{i}-C{j}" for ii,i in enumerate(ligs) for j in ligs[ii+1:]]
axB.bar(labs,d,color='#1f77b4')
axB.axhspan(3.5,4.1,color='green',alpha=0.15)
axB.text(0.02,0.93,"green band = SG-SG range of a\ntetrahedral Zn(Cys)4 site",transform=axB.transAxes,fontsize=8,va='top')
axB.set_ylabel("SG-SG distance (A)"); axB.set_ylim(0,5)
axB.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45,labelsize=8)
axB.set_title("B  AlphaFold LNPK: the four cysteines form ONE\ntetrahedral site (SG to centroid 2.09-2.28 A)",fontsize=10,loc='left')

# ---------------- Panel C: secondary structure ----------------
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ssdata = pd.DataFrame({'helix':[0.00,0.00,0.25,0.19],'strand':[0.24,0.22,0.18,0.12]},
                      index=['LNPK ZnF\n(AF)','TFIIS Zn ribbon\n1TFI','RNF4 RING\n4AP4','c-CBL RING\n1FBV'])
ssdata.plot(kind='bar',ax=axC,color=['#d62728','#1f77b4'],width=0.75)
axC.set_ylabel("fraction of residues"); axC.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=0,labelsize=8)
axC.legend(fontsize=8); axC.set_ylim(0,0.35)
axC.set_title("C  RING central alpha-helix (part of the E2 interface)\nis absent from LNPK and from zinc ribbons",fontsize=10,loc='left')

# ---------------- Panel D: Foldseek hit classes ----------------
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
cls=pd.Series({'RNA polymerase /\nribosome zinc ribbon':15,'Other zinc finger\n(NUP153, NUP358, TMEM55B)':4,
               'MCM / replication\n("pentameric ring")':4,'Other':7,'RING / U-box /\nHECT / RBR E3':0})
axD.barh(cls.index[::-1],cls.values[::-1],color=['#999','#999','#999','#999','#d62728'][::-1])
axD.set_xlabel("hits among the 30 Foldseek pdb100 matches")
axD.set_title("D  Foldseek (3Di-AA) of LNPK 265-315 vs pdb100:\nzero RING / U-box / HECT / RBR hits",fontsize=10,loc='left')
axD.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# ---------------- Panel E: control + N-terminal Cys ----------------
axE=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1]); axE.axis('off')
txt=("E  Controls and the N-terminal claim\n\n"
     "Positive control: the same Foldseek query run with a bona fide RING\n"
     "(RNF4, 4AP4 A:131-185) returned 412 hits including RNF4, RNF12,\n"
     "RNF165, RNF38, RNF8, RNF125 and TRAF6 RINGs (E 6e-10 to 1e-2).\n"
     "The method finds RINGs when a RING is present.\n\n"
     "PMID 27387505 places the ligase activity in LNPK residues 1-45:\n"
     "   MGGLFSRWRTKPSTVEVLESIDKEIQALEEFREKNQRLQKLWVGR\n"
     "   0 cysteines, 0 histidines, predicted coiled coil (UniProt 16-41).\n"
     "No catalytic Cys (HECT/RBR) and no Zn ligands (RING) are available\n"
     "in that segment.\n\n"
     "Ortholog check: the C-x2-C-x17-19-C-x2-C motif is invariant in all 13\n"
     "reviewed lunapark orthologs (yeast Lnp1 P38878 to human). Never 8 ligands.")
axE.text(0,1,txt,va='top',ha='left',fontsize=9.3,family='monospace')
plt.suptitle("LNPK (Q9C0E8) C-terminal C4 zinc finger is a zinc ribbon, not a RING/U-box E3 module",
             fontsize=13, y=0.985)
plt.show()
